# Copilot instructions

Follow [the single authoritative evaluation process](../methodology/evaluation-process.md#start-here-first-contact-protocol) and [evidence standards](../methodology/evidence-standards.md). The repository-root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) is also an entry point, **not** a second source of process rules.

Inspect source and existing evaluations before interviewing. Require explicitly approved scope for new investigations; do not infer implementation, merge or release permission.
